summary.result: The results indicated that glacier area gradually declined from $928.76km^2$ in 1990 to $918.46km^2$ in 2000 and $901.51km^2$ in 2015.
summary.background: Distinguishing debris-covered glaciers from debris-free glaciers is difficult when using only optical remote sensing images to extract glacier boundaries.According to the features that the surface temperature of debris-covered glacier is lower than surrounding objects, and higher than clean glaciers, glacial changes in the Yigong Zangbo basin was analyzed on the basis of visible, near-infrared and thermal-infrared band images of Landsat TM and OLI/TIRS in the support of ancillary digital elevation model (DEM).
summary.method: During 25 years, the glacier length became shorter continuously with terminus elevation rising up.

summary_ko.background: 광학 원격탐사를 이용하여 빙하 경계를 추출할 때, 덩어이가 덮힌 빙하와 덩어이가 없는 빙하를 구분하는 것은 어렵다. 덩어이가 덮힌 빙하의 표면 온도가 주변 물체보다 낮고, 깨끗한 빙하보다 높은 특성을 바탕으로, 라인스턴 TM 및 OLI/TIRS의 가시광선, 근적외선 및 열적외선 대역 이미지를 활용하여 앵커 디지털 고도모형(DEM)을 지원하여 야기공 장보 분지의 빙하 변화를 분석하였다.
